body: RECALL-SEAM RECONCILIATION — adopt audit v2 as the executable E0 visualization layer, with one hard status boundary. It matches the current D1B/V1 beads: retain full P and F; keep Viterbi secondary; bind exact edition axis and movie intervals; preserve source and recall evidence; account displayed mass plus remainder; name every external state; and emit zero semantic marks for SemanticsUnestablished. Do not require or synthesize term-level Ineligible in the first report: current CostBreakdown does not retain the complete eligible-term set, and the frozen visualization court requires the explicit label unavailable in this artifact unless a later checked carrier establishes eligibility. Likewise backward, long-jump, revisit, and external-excursion marks must derive from exact F endpoints and declared transition features, never layout geometry or adjacent argmax states. This reconciles existing courts only; it opens no bead, path, API, or implementation authority.
